definitions.explanation: An area where there is significant risk to safety or life — due to natural hazards, conflict, crime, or industrial conditions. Used literally on warning signs and figuratively in casual speech.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{危険地帯|きけんちたい}だ。
⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{危険地帯|きけんちたい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Because of the typhoon, this area has become a danger zone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{危険地帯|きけんちたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がって→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧おり、{民間人|みんかんじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出入|でい}り→出入り：06609_deiri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Danger zones have spread across the country at war, and civilian entry is prohibited.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧ (danger) + ⟦{地帯|ちたい}→地帯：04057_chitai⟧ (zone, area). Used in news reporting, official warnings, and casually to describe any unsafe place.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {危険地帯|きけんちたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter a danger zone
- {危険地帯|きけんちたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧: to avoid a danger zone
- {危険地帯|きけんちたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be designated a danger zone
- ⟦{紛争|ふんそう}→紛争：05758_funsou⟧{危険地帯|きけんちたい}: conflict zone

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {警戒区域|けいかいくいき}: caution/restricted area — official designation, often after disasters
- {立入禁止区域|たちいりきんしくいき}: no-entry zone — focuses on the prohibition, not the danger itself
